findings.message: model relates column "editor_id" of table "posts" to table "users", but the foreign key that links them also holds nullable column "scope_id", and under MATCH SIMPLE, the default, a row with it NULL skips the check
findings.fix: Make column "scope_id" of table "posts" NOT NULL so the foreign key checks every row: mark the field required in the model, then regenerate the migration and apply it (fill the NULLs first).

findings.message: model relates column "owner_team_id" of table "posts" to table "teams", but no foreign key does that
findings.fix: Add a foreign key from column "owner_team_id" of table "posts" to table "teams": declare the relation in the model, then regenerate the migration and apply it (repair orphaned rows first).
